terms.definition: Components in a single loop: the current is the same through each, the total p.d. is shared, and total resistance is the sum.
Components on separate branches: the p.d. across each branch is the same, and the total current is the sum of the branch currents.
terms.examiner: Adding a resistor in parallel reduces the total resistance.

terms.definition: Adding another branch gives the charge another path, so more current flows for the same p.d.
terms.examiner: Total resistance is less than the smallest resistor.
